actionable_lessons: Between her roles at Estée Lauder and LVMH, she was a managing director at the private equity firm The Carlyle Group, where she focused on deals in the consumer and retail industries, and served on the boards of portfolio companies, including the European sportswear brand Moncler S.p.A. and the American beauty brand Philosophy, Inc.
arguments: About the Author Throughout her career PAULINE BROWN has acquired, built, and led the world’s most influential brands.

Pauline formerly served as the chairman of the world’s leading luxury goods company, LVMH Moët Hennessy–Louis Vuitton North America, where she provided regional leadership for seventy brands in five sectors, including fashion and leather goods, watches and jewelry, perfume and cosmetics, wine and spirits, and selective retailing.

Earlier in her career, Pauline held senior executive positions in the global beauty industry, including head of corporate strategy and new business development at the Estée Lauder Companies, where she helped to expand the company’s portfolio from eight to twenty-five distinct beauty brands.
